_comment: checked-in golden both a Go test (internal/contracts/wire_enums_test.go, covering internal/errenv's canonical error codes and internal/authz/decision's Reason enum) and a vitest test (web/sdk/test/wireEnums.test.ts, covering web/sdk/src/types.ts's ApiErrorCode and EffectiveAccessReason) compare against.
